results.q: What are the benefits of being a Circles vendor?
results.a:
You receive Circles Points every day 

The Circles App doesn't charge you anything 

Help your customers & community fulfill their daily needs 

Build customer trust & loyalty by using Circles 

Promote your business on the Circles Market 

Support sales of locally made products 

Offer your surplus goods for Circles Points 

Support sales of local services 

Support positive social impact in your community

results.q: Does it cost anything to be a Circles Vendor?
results.a: The Circles app is free for everyone to use.

results.q: I would prefer to exchange something for a combination of Circles Points and Rupiah. Can I do that?
results.a: Yes, users can exchange goods/services with a combination of Circles Points and cash. However, both users that involved in the exchange must reach mutual agreement.

results.q: As a participating vendor, can I still exchange goods for goods or services without using Circles points?
results.a: Yes, as vendor you can choose to exchange goods with goods or services without using Circles Points. However, you will not experience the benefit provided when using Circles Points. For example, increasing the fulfillment of daily needs, cash allocation for savings or investment.

results.q: Who can Circles vendors receive Circles Points from?
results.a: Vendors can receive Circles Points from users that they have trusted on the Circles app.

results.q: How do I register as a Circles vendor?
results.a:
After creating your basic user account, you can find "create shop" via quick action menu.

1. Click on your profile picture to access quick action menu

2. Click "Create Shop"

results.q: What are the requirements to be a Circles vendor?
results.a:
Get a circles invitation from a circles vendor 

Owning a smartphone 

Have an email account 

Connect to the Internet   

Create an account on the Circles web app 

Have goods or services to offer, and be willing to offer these for Circles Points in return

As Circles Vendor, You can offer your products and services on the circles application's marketplace, and promote them there. Find other locally made products and offered services within your community. Support your community members by supporting them meet their daily needs by accepting their Circles Points for your products and services

results.q: Who determines the value of the goods or services that I exchange for Circles Points?
results.a: The value of goods/services is determined by the users involved in the exchange. For example, you can agree to give 12 Circles Points for 1kg of apples or continue to negotiate with the user you are transacting with to determine the value of the exchange.

results.q: Can I use Circles Points to restock my shop?
results.a: Yes, Circles users can exchange their Circles Points for goods/services with other Circles users that provide the goods/services that they need to restock their shop.

results.q: How can Circles help me increase my sales?
results.a: Yes, Circles can help users to increase their sales because Circles provides complementary means in the form of points. The Circles Points given to each user will provide additional resources to support users in fulfilling their daily needs by exchanging points for goods/services from your business. Each user will receive 24 Circles Points every day.

results.q: Can Circles help me sell my surplus goods?
results.a: Yes, Circles can help users to sell their surplus goods to other Circles users in exchange for Circles Points.

results.q: I want to exchange more than one item for Circles. Can I just do one transaction for multiple items, or do I need to do separate transactions for each one?
results.a: You can do one transaction for as many items as you like with the circles user that you chose to make the transaction with, as long as you have mutually agreed on the amount of circles points to be transferred for the goods/services you require.
